{{Current events|year=2022|month=04|day=25|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[April 2022 Belgorod and Bryansk attacks]]
****Two large fires occur at an oil refinery and a military depot in [[Bryansk]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/25/large-fires-break-out-russian-oil-depots-bryansk-near-ukraine-border (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast]]
****[[Kherson]] mayor [[Ihor Kolykhaiev]] announces that Russian forces have taken control of the Kherson City Council. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3467325-russian-invaders-seize-building-of-kherson-city-council-mayor.html (Ukrinform)]
***According to Ukraine, Russian missile strikes hit numerous train stations across Ukraine. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/25/russia-bombs-five-rail-stations-in-central-and-western-ukraine (''The Guardian'')]
***A person is killed after Russia bombs the [[Kremenchuk Oil Refinery]] in [[Kremenchuk]], [[Poltava Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-strikes-ukrainian-oil-depot-military-installations-2022-04-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3466664-1-killed-7-injured-in-missile-attack-on-thermal-power-plant-refinery-in-kremenchuk.html (Ukrinform)]
***Regional authorities say that five people have been killed by airstrikes on [[Zhmerynka]] and [[Koziatyn]], [[Vinnytsia Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/five-killed-russian-rocket-strikes-ukraines-vinnytsia-region-local-officials-2022-04-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Transnistria conflict]]
**[[2022 Transnistria attacks]]
***The office of the [[Ministry of State Security (Transnistria)|Transnistrian Ministry of State Security]] in [[Tiraspol]] is attacked with [[grenade launcher]]s. There is damage reported to the building, but there are no reports of casualties. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/blasts-tear-through-state-security-hq-moldovas-breakaway-region-tass-2022-04-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[List of rocket attacks from Lebanon on Israel]]
**A rocket is fired from [[Lebanon]] into [[Matzuva]], [[Israel]]. Israel responds by firing at targets in Lebanon. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/explosion-heard-near-northern-border-amid-reports-of-rocket-fired-from-lebanon/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*A [[limestone]] statue of the [[Canaanite religion|Canaanite]] goddess [[Anat]] from 2,500 BC is found in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ancient-goddess-sculpture-found-farmer-gaza-strip-84295854 (ABC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk]]
**[[Elon Musk]] reaches an agreement to buy [[Twitter]] for $44 billion. [https://www.theverge.com/2022/4/25/23028323/elon-musk-twitter-offer-buyout-hostile-takeover-ownership (''The Verge'')]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A landslide has left at least 2 dead and 9 injured in [[Bukavu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world?ns_mchannel=social&ns_source=twitter&ns_campaign=bbc_live&ns_linkname=6267cd056b7942142fe95a35%26Congolese%20mayor%20urges%20landslide%20neighbours%20to%20leave%262022-04-26T12%3A05%3A03.874Z&ns_fee=0&pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:ce990c7a-31b4-4172-9d5a-1695b128c184&pinned_post_asset_id=6267cd056b7942142fe95a35&pinned_post_type=share (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Beijing]]
****Authorities in [[Beijing]] begin COVID-19 testing for millions of residents after a recent increase in [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-61212757 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration|U.S. FDA]] formally approves the [[Gilead Sciences]] drug [[Remdesivir]], commonly known as Veklury, for young children with COVID-19. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/fda-formally-approves-gileads-veklury-for-young-children-2022-04-25 (MarketWatch)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Germany–Russia relations]]
****[[government of Russia|Russia]]'s [[Foreign Ministry of Russia|foreign ministry]] expels 40 German diplomatic staff in a retaliatory move after [[Germany]] expelled the same number of Russian [[diplomat]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-expels-40-german-diplomatic-staff-tit-for-tat-move-2022-04-25/ (Reuters)]
*Former [[Islamic Consultative Assembly|Iranian MP]] [[Ali Motahari]] says the [[Iranian nuclear program]] initially aimed for a secret [[nuclear weapon]] and [[Deterrence theory|nuclear deterrence]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202204245312 (Iran International)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in London]]
**[[2022 Bermondsey stabbing]]
***Four people are killed during a [[mass stabbing]] at a house in [[Bermondsey]], [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-61215051 (BBC News)]
